landing.metaTitle: OneFrame · AI Anime Drama Studio — one episode in 30 minutes
landing.heroTitle: Your own AI anime drama studio
landing.heroLead1: Paste a novel or type one sentence — AI writes the episode outline, character designs, storyboards and video.
landing.heroLead2: Characters stay consistent; pricing stays transparent.
landing.heroHint: Alpha is invite-only · 80 credits on sign-up · No payment method required
landing.flowStudioDesc: From script to finished cut — one place for hit short dramas
landing.flowToolsDesc: Text-to-video / image-to-video for quick single shots
landing.capSectionDesc: One-off generation is the model vendors' home turf. We build the production line: novel in, finished episodes out.
landing.capScriptDesc: Novel or one sentence → episode outline → character designs → shot list → batch generation. Every step is editable and can be re-run.
landing.capCharacterDesc: Once a reference design is bound, it is injected into every shot, so faces stay the same across shots and episodes.
landing.capPriceDesc: Model costs and credit conversion are published, quotes are live before generation, and failed or cancelled jobs cost nothing.
landing.capBatchDesc: Queue whole episodes or selected shots and cap the budget in one click; shots that hit the cap keep partial results and can be re-queued.
landing.capAssetsDesc: Results are saved to the asset library, character designs are tagged for cross-project reuse, and works can continue into the next episode.
landing.capAiDesc: A watermark on rendered frames plus file metadata — meeting generated-content labelling requirements.
landing.pipeSectionTitle: Six steps from idea to finished cut
landing.pipeSectionDesc: About 30 minutes of hands-on work; 2 hours or less end to end including queueing.
landing.pipe1Desc: Paste a novel or a one-line idea, then pick the aspect ratio
landing.pipe2Desc: AI splits it into 3–6 episodes you can edit line by line; auto-saved
landing.pipe3Desc: Extract character cards, generate reference designs and lock them in
landing.pipe4Desc: 4–30 shots per episode with numbers, visuals and prompts
landing.pipe5Desc: Pick models and budget, then queue every shot at once
landing.pipe6Desc: Download shot by shot or the whole episode as a zip with a manifest
landing.finalDesc: Alpha is invite-only. Sign-up comes with 80 credits — enough for a full episode.
landing.footerNote: Content is AI-generated — please review carefully · ICP filing 00000000 (placeholder before launch)
landing.metaDescription: Paste a novel and get storyboards and video in one pass: script pipeline, character consistency, transparent pricing. An AI anime and short-drama production studio.

pricing.redeemSub: Enter a campaign code to redeem credits or membership perks.
pricing.promoText: Credits work across all models and are billed by actual usage; failures are refunded automatically. Model prices follow the task quote and can be updated at any time.
pricing.modeNote: ⓘ Team credits are granted in one go, stack with existing credits and stay valid for one year
pricing.perk1: Works with every model, never expires
pricing.perk2: Credits are refunded on failure or cancellation
pricing.emptyDesc: No SKUs have been configured yet. Please contact the administrator or try again later.
pricing.qrWechat: Scan the QR code with WeChat to pay
pricing.qrAlipay: Scan the QR code with Alipay to pay
pricing.payLinkTip: If you were not redirected, continue payment with the button below:
pricing.notes1: Credits are frozen at the quoted price when a task is created and settled on success; failures or cancellations unfreeze them automatically;
pricing.notes2: Prices are updated by operations and the quote is snapshotted at checkout, so later price changes never affect placed orders;
pricing.notesLive: Payments are handled by the official WeChat Pay / Alipay channels. The channel notifies us asynchronously and this page confirms every 3 seconds;
pricing.notesMock: Sandbox mode (mock channel). Configure merchant credentials and enable PAYMENT_LIVE to switch to live payments.
pricing.noPayParams: The channel returned no payment parameters. Please try again later.
